notes.title: Perfect Tides 2.0 for Mac [BETA]
notes.content:
Perfect Tides for Mac now has the 2.0 update the PC version received last fall. This includes improvements to the UI and controller support.

For now, it is in Beta, and you can opt in by doing the following:
[list]
[*]Navigate to Perfect Tides in Steam, and click the gear.
[*]Go to the "Betas" tab.
[*]Enter the code "macbetaplease" to opt in to the beta.
[/list]

NOTES ABOUT THIS RELEASE:
[list]
[*]This update will break saved games. To restore your saved games, remove the opt-in code and revert to the latest release version.
[*]Steam Achievements do not work. The developer (me!) has sadly hit a wall with this one, but hopefully it can happen by the time this version leaves beta.
[/list]

Please report any issues with this build to the #bug-reports channel on the [url=https://discord.gg/ecPAXTaeGH]Perfect Tides Discord[/url] server. Thanks and happy playing!

notes.title: Perfect Tides v1.0.2
notes.content:
Quick PC + Mac update coming at you today! This Mac update consolidates the previous updates from PC build 1.0.1.

[b]Changes in this version:
[/b]
[list]
[*]Volume slider now working correctly
[*]UI now notifies player when they’ve reached max saves (50)
[*]Framed close-ups can now be exited by pressing any key
[*]small bugs fixed
[*]lots of typos fixed
[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]

[*]Game music stutters when the user tabs out under fullscreen mode. This is a known AGS issue, and a fix I was attempting (that wasn't working) has been removed. I am still trying to find a decent fix for this. However, hopefully removing the aforementioned feature will improve game functionality overall.

[*]Mac users have been reporting odd screen alignment when they start up their game in windowed mode. I'm looking into this, but for now, here is a workaround: 

[i]Click the green fullscreen button in the Mac OS window - the window will go fullscreen but be stretched out. However, if you click the green button again to go back, the window will fill correctly.

Or you can go to the settings at launch, and select "Fullscreen". The window should fill correctly.
[/i]

-----------------------

A huge THANK YOU to everyone who has played Perfect Tides since the release! As always, feel free to report any bugs in the [url=https://discord.gg/Cs47sSUxpX]Perfect Tides Discord[/url].

notes.title: Perfect Tides v1.0.1
notes.content:
So far so good with our very first release! This is just a quick patch for the PC build. Since these changes are so minor, and Mac builds are far more time-consuming, these changes will be folded into the next regular-sized update for Mac.

[b]Changes in this version:
[/b]
[list]
[*]fixed a bug that caused a collectable object to reappear
[*]moved some NPCs that were blocking a walk path
[*]fixed a typo
[*]fixed a UI bug that prevented the game from pausing when menus are open
[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]

Mac users have been reporting odd screen alignment when they start up their game in windowed mode. I'm looking into this, but for now, here is a workaround: 

[i]Launch the game. Select "Settings" from the intro screen menu. Select "Fullscreen", then reselect "Windowed". This should bring the window into correct alignment.
[/i]
-----------------------

A huge THANK YOU to everyone who has played Perfect Tides since the release! And a giant thanks and sigh of relief to the pre-release testers, who have seemingly warded off anything catastrophic in the release build. As always, feel free to report any bugs in the [url=https://discord.gg/Cs47sSUxpX]Perfect Tides Discord[/url].
